_doc: Compute nodes that run the standalone forecast cycle off-box and push a
snapshot artifact to the droplet's inbox. Copy this file to
deploy/compute-nodes.json (gitignored) and fill in the real hosts.
Why a file and not the agent's memory: a deploy step that silently skips a
node because nobody remembered it fails quietly. A missing file is loud; a
faulty recollection is not. Host details are deployment-private, so the real
list stays untracked while this example keeps the contract reviewable.
Fields:
name              short label used in deploy output
ssh               ssh target, exactly as you would type it
repo              checkout path on the node (may use ~)
branch            branch the node should track; deploys use --ff-only
venv              venv path relative to repo, for dependency reinstalls
region            artifact region prefix this node emits (eu | us)
runner            the cycle script the scheduler invokes
schedule_utc      when the node starts, UTC, for the racing-a-cycle check
cycle_minutes     rough cycle duration, to judge whether one is in flight
healthcheck_slug  healthchecks.io slug the runner pings on success
os                macos | linux — decides launchd vs cron for schedules
lan_only          true when the host is only reachable from its own network
(mDNS .local names, private IPs). The deploy skill uses
this to explain an unreachable node instead of implying
the box is down — expected when deploying from elsewhere.
notes             anything a human needs before touching the box

nodes.name: example-node
nodes.notes: Replace with the real node. Keep schedule_utc accurate — the deploy skill uses it to avoid pulling mid-cycle.
